name: W6 Invoice approval process (Capture)
description: Sign in to the approval portal, work through the queue of pending invoices, apply the approval rules to each one and report the decisions. Web steps use captured objects (recorded with OOA Capture) instead of typed selectors where the element is fixed.

variables.name: folder
variables.description: Folder of these use cases, relative to the workspace.

variables.name: headless
variables.description: Run the browser without a window (for unattended runs).

variables.name: portal_password
variables.description: Password of the demo portal (it accepts any). In a real process make this a Credential from the vault.

variables.name: limit
variables.description: Invoices above this amount go to a manager (escalated).

variables.name: approved
variables.description: Approved, as counted by the portal.

variables.name: rejected
variables.description: Rejected, as counted by the portal.

variables.name: escalated
variables.description: Escalated, as counted by the portal.
